incipText.p: Hvad er et Maal af femogtyve Aar?
Men Held os, Held! at Statens Magt er lagt i trofast Haand
Gid Du og din Dronning, Din Ungdoms fagre Brud
Bevar, o Gud, det lille Land

physDesc.physMedium: 10 folios in various sizes + 2 bifolios with the text in Carl Ploug's hand. Written in ink on 2 staves. With numerous corrections.

titlePage.p: Festmusik / til / Kong Christians Jubilæumfest. / 1888 d 17 November

physDesc.physMedium: Written in ink. Paper: 20 staves. Partly paginated. Verso of the title page and last 3 pages blank. No. 1 dated: "Juli Fredensborg / 88." and at the end of the music Gade's musical signature and the dating / "Sommeren / 1888 / Fredensborg".

Bound in black cardboard cover. On the paste-down in Gade's hand: "Festmusik / opført / Universitetets Solennitets-Sal / d. 17de Novbr 1888 / ved Kong Christian d. IXs Jubilæumsfest. / Text af Dr. Ploug / Musik af Niels W. Gade.". Written in purple and black ink. Headings in Gade's hand. In the margin of the first music page: "(Partituret opskreven af Musiker Organist P. Rasmussen Septr. Oct. 1888.)". Each number is paginated separately.
